education.degree: Ph.D. in Electronics and Information Convergence Engineering
education.specialization: Quantum computing, quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum–classical algorithms, and quantum communication

education.institution: National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)

bullets: Developed machine-learning-based frameworks for quantum state classification, state discrimination, and quantum error mitigation on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices.

Engineered variational quantum circuits on IBM Quantum backends for hybrid quantum–classical optimization, including VQE- and QUBO-based formulations for network scheduling and NP-hard decision problems.
Designed and evaluated quantum algorithms for next-generation intelligent networks, with applications in edge intelligence, resource optimization, and secure quantum communication.
Investigated reinforcement-learning-based quantum control, pulse-level gate design, and anonymous quantum semantic communication protocols for reliable and privacy-preserving quantum networks.
Led and contributed to journal manuscript preparation, including technical writing, result analysis, figure design, reviewer-response preparation, and submissions.
Contributed to funded research programs through proposal writing, project planning, technical documentation, progress reports, and research outcome preparation.

Supported lab operations by coordinating research activities, mentoring junior students, assisting new student admissions and onboarding, and guiding students in experiments, implementation, and academic writing.

Architected hardware–software co-design solutions on Xilinx Zynq-7000 SoC platforms, programming the embedded ARM Cortex-A9 processor in C for low-latency hardware control and real-time data orchestration.
Engineered high-throughput RTL modules in Verilog and VHDL using Vivado, implementing real-time DSP pipelines for FIR filtering, FFT processing, fixed-point conversion, and DDR memory interfacing.
Designed and integrated high-speed mixed-signal processing interfaces for ADC/DAC data acquisition, SMA-based signal routing, and clock synchronization in microwave system testbeds.
Translated signal-processing algorithms into deployable FPGA-based hardware implementations, ensuring robust system integration, timing closure, and reliable real-time performance.
